headline: Costco beat estimates with U.S. comps up 6.4% ex gas, and its CEO pledged any tariff refunds back to members.

metrics.comp_label: Costco U.S. comp ex gas & FX

guidance_note: Costco does not give earnings guidance.
key_messages: U.S. comps +5.9% reported, +6.4% ex gas and FX; total company +7.4% / +6.7% adjusted.
Worldwide traffic +3.1%, ticket +4.2% (+3.5% ex gas/FX); site traffic +32%, app +45%.
Membership fee income $1.355B (+13.6%); paid executive members +9.5% to 40.4M.
CEO said any IEEPA tariff refunds would go back to members via lower prices; Costco hadn't passed full tariffs through.
Management flagged Middle East tensions raising fuel and shipping costs.

consumer.pricing: Tariffs only partly passed on; any refunds pledged to lower prices. Gas prices deflationary in the quarter.

macro_read: Steady traffic and membership growth through winter 2026 point to a resilient core consumer, with tariffs and energy costs the main watch items.

sources.label: Alpha Spread: Costco beats in fiscal Q2, CEO pledges tariff refunds
